outcome.reason: Customer used abusive language and refused to continue.

transcript.text: Hello, this is a call from Mumbai Bank. May I speak with Rakesh Sharma?
Why do you people keep calling me? I've told you before, I'm not interested.
Thank you for letting me know. Just to confirm, am I speaking with Rakesh Sharma? If not, I apologize for the inconvenience and will call back later.
Yeah, you’re speaking to him, but I swear, I’m sick of these calls. Stop wasting my time!

Thank you for confirming, Mr. Sharma. I apologize for any trouble these calls have caused you. I’ll be brief.

I'm calling regarding your Mumbai Bank credit card. As of today, there is a minimum amount due of Rs 4,820, which was due on 2026-10-15. May I know if you have already made this payment, or when you plan to make it?
Fuck off with this shit! I’m not paying you anything, got it? Stop calling me!
